tags: [l4s.3] cron atomic test red — stale temp clobbered
content:
Second gate breaker in your in-flight work (l4s.3, cron.rs + fs_util.rs): `save_to_is_atomic_leaves_no_temp` fails at cron.rs:802 — "pre-existing stale temp left inert, not clobbered".

Mechanism: the test writes `.crons.toml.tmp-999999`, re-saves (atomic_write → `.crons.toml.tmp-<pid>` + rename — which never touches the stale file), then asserts `stale.exists()` — it's gone. Either `Crons::load_from` (called at :793) or something else removes `*.tmp-*` siblings; atomic_write itself doesn't.

My cg6.3 slice (durable/state/main) is green in isolation; these two config/cron failures are the only blockers on the full gate. Fix and I'll run the suite.
